meta.notice: Compact UI starter selection only; not exhaustive.

groups.title: Tier-I
groups.caption: Four subject areas · based on the 2026 notice

items.label: General Intelligence & Reasoning
items.note: Verbal and non-verbal reasoning, including analogies, series, coding/decoding and inference.

items.label: Analogies
items.note: Starter topic for the first draft lesson.

items.label: General Awareness
items.note: Broad scope includes current events, environment, History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene, General Policy and Scientific Research.

items.label: Quantitative Aptitude
items.note: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry, mensuration, trigonometry and charts/graphs.

items.label: English Comprehension
items.note: Understanding correct English, basic comprehension and writing ability.

groups.title: Tier-II · Paper-I
groups.caption: Paper-I modules and DEST · eligibility and scheme must follow the notice

items.label: Mathematical Abilities
items.note: Includes Number Systems and the mathematical ability scope listed in the notice.

items.label: Reasoning and General Intelligence
items.note: Keep this Paper-I module distinct from the Tier-I subject.

items.label: English Language and Comprehension
items.note: Paper-I English module; don't silently merge it with Tier-I scope.

items.label: Computer Knowledge / Proficiency
items.note: Computer module listed in the 2026 notice.

items.label: Data Entry Speed Test (DEST)
items.note: Skill/qualifying component as specified by the applicable notice.

groups.title: Tier-II · Paper-II
groups.caption: Statistics · for candidates to whom the paper applies

items.label: Statistics
items.note: Includes presentation, central tendency, dispersion, probability, distributions, sampling, inference, ANOVA, time series and index numbers.

groups.title: Tier-II · Paper-III
groups.caption: Finance and Economics · for candidates to whom the paper applies

items.label: General Studies — Finance and Economics
items.note: Finance and Accounts, CAG, Finance Commission, microeconomics, markets, Indian Economy, reforms, money/banking, fiscal matters and IT in governance.
